Summary.Name: DeepRV
Summary.Description: Classify right ventricle function as normal or abnormal from angiograms.

Uses_and_directions.General_use: This model can be used to classify right ventricle function as normal or abnormal from angiograms.
Uses_and_directions.Target_population_and_use_case: This model is intended for use in the cardiac imaging field to assist in the diagnosis of right ventricular dysfunction.
Uses_and_directions.Before_using_this_model: Before using this model, please ensure that the input data is in the correct format and that the model is trained on the appropriate data.

Warnings_and_limitations.Image_Quality: The model requires high-quality angiograms with clear visualization of the right ventricle.
Warnings_and_limitations.Multiple_Devices: The model is designed to classify a single right ventricle in the video.
Warnings_and_limitations.Confidence_Scores: Current threshold applied on probability output for classification is 0.1
